# Run gaps — manually recorded

Defects this run DISCOVERED but deliberately did not build. Each was measured, each has a named
site, and each is filed as an independent slice on a disjoint surface so a later run can take them
at whatever width the backlog allows.

gap: sink-classifier — the main-root preflight (sink-merge.js ~:1697) still exempts a literal-backslash filename that the worktree guard now refuses over; #978 fixed the shared worktree guard and deliberately left the preflight, which the premise record had listed as "not measured"

gap: sink-rescue — a sink that stages the journal and then red-stops BEFORE landing leaves the only surviving copy parked in an unnamed kw-wtsync-* tmpdir reported nowhere the operator will look; pre-existing, same class as #619(4), inherited not widened by #978

gap: installer-retirement — retired SUPPORT SCRIPTS survive an opencode or kimi --uninstall; both editions remove support scripts by the CURRENT manifest, so #977's declaration model does not reach them; mildest of the class because a reinstall heals it

gap: test-harness — the GNU-shaped mktemp shim's -p/-t precedence diverges from real coreutils, a latent false-green for any FUTURE temp-root fix written with mktemp -p; no current site uses -p, so nothing is wrong today

gap: test-coverage — the sink stage's unreadable-file (EACCES) trigger is unfixtured because a permission fixture INVERTS UNDER ROOT (chmod 000 does not deny root), so the pin would pass for the wrong reason; arms (m)/(n) drive symlink triggers only
